source_readback.conclusion: The unchanged actual recorder classifies declared method/path requests and preserves separate success/rejection/transport cells. Final source requires 14 positive target cells and only cancellation/unlock absent; it does not populate a 37/2 result. Main remains fixed-error/redacted and no-replace.

The new private fixture uses normal prepare/explicit commit producers and registers the generated applicability report as the seventh resource. No report bytes are authored. Positive conversion and preview GETs use accepted real IDs in the creating session before preview consumption; later distinct-session negatives do not accept the two documented status discrepancies.

Flat capture streams at most 16 regular nonlink files with 1MiB reads, HTTP paths are only matched to captured names, resource hash/size/version are exact, page envelopes close and retain stable totals/version with complete termination, cursor/duplicate/cycle limits hold, and excerpts bind actual whole UTF-8 lines/hash/truncation. APIF-01 is the known identifier format omission. This does not establish full schema validation of every queue/provenance row.

At most 200 delegated calls share the same finite 300-second monotonic pass fence, with equality/late return failure. The complete additional fixture also caps actual request delta including teardown. Existing startup/request/cleanup ceilings remain; this is not preemption or a hard total-wall-clock limit. Each extra session requires natural zero exit and an actual post-close transport refusal.

An eighth source is normally uploaded/registered while valid, then changed to invalid UTF-8 only after shutdown. Config cases and valid rationale stale-report mutation occur while stopped. Report-view scope-only historical pin after a changed scope matches existing report_input_fingerprints behavior. Synthetic reviewer values confer no authentic human review.

The proposed 31 tests use actual recorder/library parsing with fake HTTPConnection and clock, retain route/outcome accounting, exact commit/poll semantics and negative boundaries. Seven-file FunctionalFixture bytes and its domain responses are explicitly synthetic; they do not establish genuine domain report generation, actual HTTP requests or native lifecycle. Public receipt shape is unchanged; fixture paths/bodies/text/capabilities stay private.

entries = bounded_pages(budget, client, "/api/v1/provenance/entries", {"anchor": policy["resource_id"]})
    assert len(entries) >= 2 and [row["entry_id"] for row in entries] == sorted(row["entry_id"] for row in entries)
    assert bounded_pages(budget, client, "/api/v1/provenance/entries", {"anchor": policy["resource_id"], "kind": "source-reference"}) == [row for row in entries if row["kind"] == "source-reference"]
    assert all(row["fingerprint"] in {item["sha256"] for item in resources} for row in entries if "fingerprint" in row)
    excerpts = sorted({reference for row in entries for reference in row.get("excerpt_refs", [])})
    assert excerpts and len(excerpts) <= 16
    for reference in excerpts:
        excerpt = budget.request(client, "GET", "/api/v1/provenance/excerpts/" + reference)
        assert excerpt["excerpt_id"] == reference
        inspect_excerpt(excerpt, by_id, before)

ProvenanceEntry:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [entry_id, kind, label, refs]
      properties:
        entry_id:
          type: string
          pattern: '^prov_[0-9a-z]{12,80}$'
        kind:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProvenanceKind'

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
          description: Safe, bounded display label.

          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Sha256Hex'
